plain: Just beginning to form or appear

webster.text: Beginning to exist or to grow; coming into being.

example.quote: I pretend neither to the spirit of prophecy nor any uncommon skill in predicting a crisis, much less to tell when it begins to be "nascent" or is fairly midwived into the world.
example.cite: James Otis, The Rights of the British Colonies Asserted and Proved (Boston, 1764)
